collection.title: Ford Mondeo Saloon 2015 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Mondeo Saloon 2015 Onwards model requires a 27" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Pinch Tab Arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
